raw.query: WITH x AS (SELECT d.run_id, CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%235b_tp8%' THEN '235B-TP8' ELSE '8B-TP1' END AS model, regexp_replace(split_part(d.run_id,'_s',2),'p','.')::double precision AS s, d.window_name,d.window_span_s,d.window_requests,d.tp,d.is_current,d.superseded_by,l.p99_ms AS itl_p99_ms,l.n_requests FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current AND l.is_current AND d.experiment='g3_32b' AND d.run_id ~ '(235b_tp8|8b_tp1)_s(0p125|0p5|1|2)$' AND l.pool='language' AND l.sla_metric='itl'), p AS (SELECT s,max(itl_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE model='235B-TP8') AS p235,max(itl_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE model='8B-TP1') AS p8 FROM x GROUP BY s) SELECT model,s,round(itl_p99_ms::numeric,3) AS itl_p99_ms,n_requests,window_requests,window_name,window_span_s,tp,is_current,(superseded_by IS NULL) AS not_superseded,round((CASE WHEN model='235B-TP8' THEN p235/p8 ELSE p8/p235 END)::numeric,3) AS p99_ratio_to_other FROM x JOIN p USING(s) ORDER BY s,model
raw.evidence: The integer knee direction is compatible with s=1 versus s=2, but the claimed 87.7 ms is 86.151 ms in the owning current view and the ratio is not ~2x throughout, ranging from 1.360x to 3.808x.
